reset_convention: root pose and joint positions from clip frame 0; root linear velocity from a one-frame finite difference at 50 Hz; root angular velocity from the body-frame quaternion delta; joint velocities from the clip. Reset WITH reference velocities.
verified: observations and actions come from the same ONNX session the MuJoCo reference player uses
not_verified: that the C++ runner reproduces these actions -- that is the test these vectors exist to make possible, and it has never been run
